description: This file defines logging-related classes, functions, and macros for the Thunder project. It includes declarations for dumping exceptions and system files, and a template class for logging categories with methods to control and query logging status. It also provides macros for defining categories and logging messages.

classes.name: BaseLoggingType
classes.description: A template class representing a logging category type, providing methods to check if logging is enabled, enable/disable logging, and access metadata.

methods.name: DumpException
methods.description: External function to dump exception details based on exception type.

methods.name: DumpSystemFiles
methods.description: External function to dump system files related to a process ID.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Static method to announce the logging category (calls IsEnabled).

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the Control type for the category.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if logging is enabled for the category.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables logging for the category.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Returns metadata associated with the logging category.
